# The shared dialog demo leaves the catalog: dock tear-out carries that proof

## Context

**Re-cut on 22 Nov, an hour after filing, on the operator's correction.** This ticket first asked to renew `apps/shareddialog` and called a dialog dragged between two windows "one of the two strongest proofs of the Multi-Window group". That was taken from a slate row of 18 Nov and it is not true any more. The operator, 22 Nov: the demo predates dock layouts, it has no drag proxy while the dialog crosses windows, and dock tear-out, which turns a drag proxy into a popup window on the fly, is vastly superior; the web desktop uses a more advanced form of that pattern. "It was true, 5 years ago."

## The Problem

The Multi-Window group still shows the superseded demo as a card: record `multi-window-drag-drop` ("Multi-Window Drag&Drop"), cross-listed in Apps and in Drag & Drop, with the cover `devmode/multi_window_dd.png` from before the Engine 14 covers. A visitor who opens it meets the engine's cross-window story in its oldest form, beside the cards that tell it today: Dock Perspectives and Pop-outs, Dock Pane Pop-out, the Workstation and the Web Desktop.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/shareddialog` is still loaded by two end-to-end specs, `test/playwright/e2e/portal/StoredThemeBoot.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/e2e/neural-link/CreateComponentMultiWindow.spec.mjs`, and `src/container/Viewport.mjs` names it. So the folder cannot simply go.
- The record lives in the catalog and in `seo.json`.
- #21140's content table listed this entry as a renewal; that row is corrected to "leaves the catalog".

## The Fix

The record `multi-window-drag-drop` leaves the catalog, and with it its entries in Apps and in Drag & Drop and its line in `seo.json`. The app's folder stays where the two specs load it. Whether the app is deleted is a separate question for after the cut, once those specs run on another fixture; this ticket does not decide it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No catalog record points at `apps/shareddialog`; Multi-Window, Apps and Drag & Drop no longer show the card.
- [ ] `seo.json` and the sitemap carry no entry for it.
- [ ] The two specs that load the app pass unchanged.
- [ ] The look: the Multi-Window page at 1440×900 in Neo Dark, before and after, on the pull request.

## Out of Scope

Deleting `apps/shareddialog` or moving its specs. Any renewal of the demo. The dock examples and the web desktop, which carry the proof.

## Avoided Traps

- **Renewing a demo because a slate row says so.** A row written from the folder list does not know that a newer capability has taken over its claim. Before a renewal, ask what proves that claim best in the engine today.
